connector.name: PrismHR MCP
connector.registryDescription: Open-source MCP server for PrismHR. PEO workflow tools + Microsoft 365 connectors.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package prismhr-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nikulk2992-jpg account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PRISMHR_MCP_PEO_ID
env.description: PrismHR PEO identifier. Ask your PrismHR admin for the value assigned to your web service user.

env.name: PRISMHR_MCP_USERNAME
env.description: PrismHR API username. Alternatively use 1Password via PRISMHR_MCP_ONEPASSWORD_VAULT + PRISMHR_MCP_ONEPASSWORD_ITEM_PRISMHR.

env.name: PRISMHR_MCP_ONEPASSWORD_VAULT
env.description: 1Password vault name (requires op CLI signed in). Overridden by direct USERNAME/PASSWORD.

env.name: PRISMHR_MCP_ALLOW_PROD
env.description: Must be 'true' to allow PRISMHR_MCP_ENVIRONMENT=prod. Safety default keeps first-run posture on UAT.
